title: Game checks on Linux and macOS
text: Linux and macOS game checks (or label them), no-Java install on each.
result: Linux, part proven: on a fresh boat.dev Ubuntu machine with no GPU, the behaviour checks (a hidden client on a virtual display, software OpenGL) passed and failed on their breaks, and data-check passed (bench/session-cost/behaviour-boat-2026-11-07.txt, data-check-boat-2026-11-07.txt). macOS and the no-Java install are not checked.
